notes.title: Roadmap 2025
notes.content:
[h3][b]The new features won't necessarily arrive in the order indicated, as I'm developing the game on my own, so deadlines aren't fixed,
if you want to support me, the best way is to add Hunted Hunter to your wishlist.[/b][/h3]

[h2][b]Roadmap :[/b][/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205636/a75429bf422ccab50c15c23994bce2420529ce82.png[/img]


[h3][b]A few details[/b][/h3]

[b]1-[/b] The single-player mode will be a procedurally-generated dungeon, where the aim will be to achieve the highest possible score, with difficulty increasing as the levels progress.

[b]2-[/b] There will now be 3 objects to throw, 3 different grenades and a mine, the selection will be made with a wheel. 

[b]3-[/b] A variety of items can be picked up, including grenade refills, life recovery, a faster-movement item and much more.

notes.title: November 12 update notes
notes.content:
- Fixed bug not disconnecting players expelled from the lobby when the host leaves the game.
- Modification and addition of precision on the choice of the number of players to be teleported to the game map.
- Added option to invert horizontal camera movements.
- Added option to reverse vertical camera movements.

notes.title: MAJ Halloween
notes.content:
- New map added (HalloweenMap)
- New grenade visual
- Added transformation effect
- Fixed various minor bugs

notes.title: Thank you
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone,[/h1]

First of all I'd like to thank you for the support you've given me by putting the game on your wish list.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45205636/d365c547871455376a84a5c28196b0c66ac74341.png[/img]


Developing a game alone is not an easy thing every day, and I'm pleased to announce that v0.1 is soon ready and will be the first playable version available on Steam.

Thanks again, without you this kind of independent project wouldn't be possible.
